coverage_rule.eligible_weight: sum of weights of all registered components
coverage_rule.covered_weight: sum of weights of components with valid inputs
coverage_rule.renormalization_policy: allowed only when coverage_ratio >= default_coverage_gate; original and effective weights both reported
coverage_rule.roic_rule: ROIC absence reduces enterprise_quality coverage; never zero; never silently reweighted away

confidence_rule.stage2f_gap_effect: 9 dividend exchange-payload gaps  reduce evidence confidence by an explicit rule; they do not lower the business-quality score
confidence_rule.stage2h_gap_effect: 2 missing_evidence risk slots reduce evidence confidence; they are not a negative conclusion
confidence_rule.roic_gap_effect: 7 ROIC gaps reduce enterprise_quality coverage and evidence confidence; never a zero or poor-capital-return claim
confidence_rule.confidence_not_quality: evidence confidence must never be described as business quality

risk_veto_rule.triggered_veto_action: risk_and_evidence_integrity -> blocked_by_risk_veto; veto surfaced beside every dimension

cycle_rule.cyclical_interpretation: oil/gas cyclical; low PE at a possible cycle peak must not automatically receive a high valuation score
cycle_rule.history_window: 5-year window for quality; 3y/5y/expanding PIT percentiles for valuation

weight_modes.evidence_card: no aggregation; each component shown as evidence
